description: The record of the scale layer: the deploy topology, module ownership and the triggers that would justify moving along the spectrum.
Team count, domain ownership, deploy cadence and coupling of changes. Micro-frontends and monorepos answer these, not technical problems.
A measurable signal written in the ADR (a new autonomous team, a domain that must release alone) that turns "not now" into "not until X".
Each module has one owning team, usually encoded in `CODEOWNERS`, so reviews and incidents have a clear address.
Separate deployables that must still be released together. The result of splitting before the organizational forces require it.
